text: My tomato seedlings are getting leggy on the windowsill. How much light do they need before I move them outside?
Should I harden off the tomato seedlings over a week, or can I plant them in the raised bed straight away?
What compost ratio works best in a raised vegetable bed for tomatoes and peppers?
Switching subjects: I want to bake sourdough bread this weekend. How long should the starter ferment before I mix the dough?
My sourdough loaves come out dense. Is that underproofing, or is my oven temperature too low?
Can I retard the sourdough dough in the fridge overnight and bake it cold in the morning?
New topic: tonight I want to look at Jupiter through my small telescope. Which eyepiece shows the cloud bands best?
When will Jupiter's moons line up on one side of the planet this month, and can I see them with binoculars?
How do I align the telescope's finder scope before the planets rise?
Different question: my road bike chain keeps skipping on the rear cassette when I climb. Is the chain worn out?
How do I measure bicycle chain stretch with a ruler, and at what point should I replace the chain and cassette together?
What tyre pressure should I run on 28 mm road bike tyres for a long ride on rough roads?
